name: answer-card
description: macOS topmost floating card for Antigravity: approve tool calls, answer agent questions, and jump back or follow up on turn completion without switching windows.
suggestedPrompts: 发送一张 Answer Card 测试卡片，检查悬浮窗位置和样式
把 Answer Card 悬浮窗改成光标附近弹出，宽度 500，开启提示音
把当前工作区加入 Answer Card 静音列表，或查看当前所有设置
